decisions.rationale: The bounded single-test diagnostic completed naturally and isolated a stale synthetic response, not a controller hang. The current controller correctly requires setup_names_required for null setup_overview. Updating the one test response preserves the strict contract and restores intended cleanup coverage at negligible complexity/risk/cost.
decisions.smallest_fix: In the owned controller test fixture only, replace the stale status ok response with the exact setup_names_required response and optional connection_assignments shape; do not weaken production.
